lines.text: Thanks for calling Clearline Dermatology. We're closed for the night, but I can book consultations and answer questions. How can I help?
How much is Botox? It's my first time — does it hurt?

From our price list, the forehead and frown lines are one hundred ninety dollars per area, and the jawline starts at three hundred ninety. Pain and results vary from person to person, so I can't speak to those — the doctor goes through them with you at the consultation. Which area are you thinking of?
Forehead and frown lines. When could I come in?
I have a consultation slot this Thursday at three PM. Shall I book that for you?
Yes, let's do that.
Can I get your name and a mobile number?
Seoyeon Lee, five five five, zero three one four.
Thank you, Seoyeon. You're booked for Thursday at three. Since it's your first visit, just bring a photo ID. I'll text you a confirmation now — is text okay? And how did you find us?
